text:
alex: Hey — opened PR #2607 for the kv cache rename + a tiny proto field reorder. CI passed locally but cloud CI is failing gofumpt.
maya: I skimmed, looks fine. what's the failing message from gofumpt? can you paste the diff?
alex: gist: ```diff\n- func DoThing(ctx context.Context, opts ...Option) error {\n+ func DoThing(ctx context.Context, opts ...Option) error {\n }\n``` (weird linewrap from our formatter + the proto change triggered reformat)
riyad: quick idea: run `gofumpt -w ./...` and commit. sometimes the pre-commit hook changes more than expected.
alex: did that, then commit got large. pre-commit also fixed a couple of small varname nits (kv -> kvCache) which I wasn't sure about.
maya: tagging @owners:ryiad for approval? we need two approvers. I'll give one once CI is happy. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build/ci — failed — gofumpt mismatch in 2 files (pkg/server/cache.go, proto/gen/kv.pb.go)
alex: proto/gen is generated — shouldn't be committed. my bad, the generated file slipped in after a regen step.
alex: plan: revert generated file from the commit, re-run gofumpt only on source, push force to the branch. ok to force-push?
riyad: fine to force-push here, but add a short commit message: "remove generated file, reformat" and note regen steps in PR body.
maya: also add a short note in the PR about why kv->kvCache rename happened (was a lint rule); less surprise for reviewers.
alex: done. pushed, CI requeued.
ci-bot: build/ci — success — all green :white_check_mark:
maya: LGTM (1/2). riyad you good to approve?
riyad: looks good, approve from me. landed after squash? alex, do you want me to squash+merge or do you prefer you land?
alex: please squash+merge, small tidy. thanks both!
maya: thanks — nice cleanup. :tada:
